intro: A few projects I have led, presented the way I would present them to a client: the context, my role, what I did and what came out of it.

etudes.titre: This website, run as a client project
etudes.contexte: A personal website that presents my background to recruiters and partners, with a private area opened by a personal link. I run it to the standards of a client project: milestones, exit criteria and security by design.
etudes.role: Project manager and technical lead: scoping, architecture choices, security requirements, managing development and reviewing every change.
enjeux: Present a background that can be checked, with public source code
Apply to a small project the security standards I advocate on large ones
Keep it simple to host and to develop further
actions: Full scoping before the first line of code: needs, audiences, site structure, architecture and hosting
Six-milestone roadmap, each milestone with a verifiable exit criterion
Monitored delivery pipeline: review of every change, automated tests, code and image scanning, tracked dependencies
Hardened server behind Cloudflare, strict security headers, no third-party trackers
Private area with personal links that expire and can be revoked, tokens stored only as hashes
resultats: Source code and decision history publicly available
Page security and accessibility checked automatically on every change
French and English versions generated from the same data

etudes.titre: Digital projects for the public sector
etudes.contexte: Since 2020, I have been running application development, cybersecurity and trusted cloud projects for French government ministries and the public sector.
etudes.role: Senior project manager (Engagement Manager), accountable for each project from scoping to delivery.
enjeux: Deliver software to clients with high security requirements
Hold budget, margin and contractual commitments across several projects at once
Get development teams and business stakeholders working together
actions: Bid responses and scoping of engagements
Built and managed teams of 5 to 10 people
Project governance using agile at scale (SAFe, Scrum) and risk management
Financial and contract management: budget, margin, contract amendments
Protection of information and access on projects, as Security Officer
resultats: More than 30 projects led, worth €500k to €2M each
etudes.note: For confidentiality reasons, no client, programme or detailed figures are named here.

etudes.contexte: During my gap year, I was a communications officer in the French Army's human resources chain, in Tours.
etudes.role: Editor-in-chief and functional lead for RH-Terre, the French Army's HR website, heading the editorial unit.
enjeux: Keep French Army personnel informed on human resources matters
Develop the website together with the departments concerned
actions: Set the editorial line and managed the editorial unit
Photo reports, events and communication materials
